note: A single shaded back-in dirt site for up to ten people on Nelson Run Road, about 0.9 mile from Wild Boy Road. The agency's routes: from the south, East Fork Road (SR 3001) to Wild Boy Road, 2.7 miles, then left onto Nelson Run Road; from the north, Prouty Road to Wild Boy Road, 1.4 miles, then right onto Nelson Run Road. The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude

flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', dirt driveway. No Severe grade, no site-specific 4WD or wet-weather statement; clearance 20 ft. Kept. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Equestrian check: the Susquehannock camping page names the Dyer and Horsey Hilton equestrian areas; this site is neither and its page lists no horse category.
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page or GIS record places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Susquehannock advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office closure Oct 17-18, 2026, Rausch Road reopened July 31, 2025, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads', a dust advisory; nothing on this site's road.
